The owner selected: "Yes, clear them". No message id exists for that channel, so none is recorded: an invented identifier is worse than an absent one. what_this_does_not_do: It changes no AWS resource, no charge and no ceiling. It deletes no attempt and re-prices nothing. It does not touch the two running instances the owner was told about.
